_comment: BBP amendment 20: element names and automation ids that make desktop.uia.invoke high risk (it needs your approval). Shared by the Brain (jarvis_v1/action/ui_policy.py) and the Body (body/src/Jarvis.Desktop/RiskyNames.cs); both test suites check the examples. Matching: Unicode NFKC, format (zero-width) characters removed, common Cyrillic/Greek look-alikes folded to Latin, camelCase and digits split, case ignored; then whole words (plus the endings s, es, ed, d, ing) or phrases (also written as one word). A word mixing Latin with other letters counts as risky. If this file is missing or broken, every invoke counts as risky (fail closed).
